neighbours.label: strict or exact specification of how something must be (dictated, constant speed, detailed designs, consistent with a standard); the + pole is the other side: loose 'general / broad guidelines'
fire: The architect handed us detailed floor plans that left no room for change.
Every page must follow the exact layout specified in the style manual.
The pump keeps the fluid moving at a constant rate.
The rules are strictly dictated by the national federation.
Each part is cut to precise measurements set by the client.
The schedule is rigidly determined by the airline's head office.
Our menu is fixed and prescribed by the owner each season.
The colours must be consistent with the official brand standard.
quiet: The architect gave us a rough idea of where the rooms might go.
Every page can loosely follow whatever layout feels natural.
The pump moves the fluid whenever someone turns it on.
The rules are loosely suggested by the national federation.
Each part is cut to roughly the size the client mentioned.
The schedule is broadly shaped by the airline's head office.
Our menu changes freely whenever the cook feels like it.
The colours can be anything that looks cheerful to you.

notes: Weak pole (max 10.9) with varied peak tokens; a probe pair did not separate strict from loose phrasing (0.32 vs 0.24).
